title: Dal Makhani
description: Whole black lentils and kidney beans, slow-simmered with butter and cream until rich and velvety — a weekend, restaurant-style dal.
steps: Drain the soaked urad dal and rajma, and pressure cook together with the water for 8-10 whistles, until both are completely soft. Whisk lightly to break some of the lentils and thicken the mixture.
In a separate pan, heat butter over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle, then add the ginger-garlic paste and onion, and sauté until the onion is golden.
Add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates, about 8-10 minutes. Stir in the red chilli powder and salt.

Add the cooked dal and rajma along with their cooking liquid. Simmer on low heat, stirring occasionally, for 30-40 minutes — the longer it simmers, the creamier it gets. Add water if it thickens too much.
Stir in the cream and garam masala, and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Finish with a small knob of butter on top before serving with rice or naan.
